dct_description_sm:
Brampton Plan (Official Plan) Land Use data is composed of polygons defining the Land Use policies areas for NW Brampton Urban Development Area. This data is part of the Official Plan mapping data series and is intended to be combined with all of the related Official Plan datasets to form a complete map. 

Brampton Plan establishes a range of designations shown on Schedule 2, which form Our Strategy for Building an Urban City. Schedule  1A identifies the different overlays that apply, identifying key areas for growth over the planning horizon of this Plan.

The Northwest Brampton Development Area is a strategically planned growth area intended to accommodate new residential communities, employment opportunities, parks, schools, infrastructure, and supporting services. Development is guided by approved secondary plans and city-building objectives that promote complete and connected communities.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
